name: Dynasmon
main_effect:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing your top security card, all of your opponent's Digimon get -6000 DP for the turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until your turn ends. Then, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
